mapper.select: SELECT id, task_no, record_id, channel_instance_id, channel_type_code, instance_code, instance_name, status, retry_count, max_retry_count, next_retry_time, started_time, finished_time, response_summary, last_error, creator_id, create_time, updater_id, update_time, deleted FROM alert_send_task WHERE deleted = 0 AND status IN ('WAITING', 'RETRYING') AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= NOW()) ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
